text: The Consultant shall not, for a period of two years after termination of this Agreement, engage in any business similar to that of the Company.
The Employee agrees not to join any competitor of the Company for 12 months following the end of employment.
Vendor will not compete with the Client in any manner after expiry of this Agreement within India.
During the term of this Agreement, the Consultant shall not provide similar services to a direct competitor of the Company.
For twelve months after termination, neither party shall solicit the other's employees with whom it worked.
Any dispute shall be referred to a sole arbitrator appointed by the Company, whose decision shall be final.
The arbitral tribunal shall consist of a sole arbitrator nominated solely by the Employer from its panel.
Disputes shall be resolved by a sole arbitrator chosen by the Client.
Disputes shall be resolved by a sole arbitrator appointed by mutual consent of the parties, failing which by the High Court under section 11.
The arbitrator shall be appointed by the Mumbai Centre for International Arbitration under its rules.
Invoices shall be paid within ninety (90) days of receipt of invoice.
The Company shall make payment within 60 days of invoice submission.
Payment shall be made in 120 days from receipt of a valid invoice.
The Client shall pay each invoice within thirty (30) days of acceptance of the deliverable.
Payment is due within 45 days of acceptance.
The Contractor shall be paid only after receipt of payment from the end customer for the corresponding work.
Payment to the Sub-contractor is subject to receipt of payment from its client.
The Client shall pay on acceptance regardless of whether the Client's own customer has paid.
Any claim shall be barred and deemed waived unless brought within 60 days of the event giving rise to it.
Claims shall be extinguished if not made within three months of completion.
A party shall give written notice of any claim within 60 days; this does not limit the period to sue.
A penalty of 2% per day of delay shall be levied on the Supplier.
The security deposit shall stand forfeited and 10% shall be deducted for late delivery.
Late delivery attracts liquidated damages of 0.5% of the milestone fee per week, capped at 10% of that fee, as a genuine pre-estimate of loss.
The Vendor shall have unlimited liability for any breach of this Agreement.
The Service Provider shall indemnify the Client against any and all losses arising from the services.
Each party's total liability is limited to the fees paid in the twelve months before the claim.
The Freelancer hereby assigns all copyright in the deliverables to the Client.
The Freelancer assigns all intellectual property in the work to the Company upon payment.
The Freelancer assigns all copyright in the deliverables to the Client throughout the world for the full term of copyright.
The Agency will process customer data received from the Client to run marketing campaigns.
The Vendor will store user data on its servers for analytics.
The Processor will handle personal data only on instructions, keep security safeguards, report any breach within 24 hours, and delete data at the end.
This Agreement is governed by the laws of India and the courts at Bengaluru have exclusive jurisdiction.
The Consultant shall keep all confidential information secret for three years after termination.
There is no penalty for early termination by either party on thirty days' notice.
The Company may terminate this Agreement for convenience on 30 days notice.
Fees are exclusive of GST, which shall be paid at the applicable rate.
Notwithstanding anything herein, the Supplier waives all claims unless raised within 15 days, after which they shall not be entertained.
The Licensee shall pay within 75 days of the date of invoice, and the Licensor shall not compete after termination of the licence.
Following cessation of employment, the Employee must not take up work with any rival or similar business for eighteen months.
The Partner agrees not to, for one year post termination, start or join any competing venture.
The Seller agrees not to compete within Pune for three years in connection with the sale of the goodwill of the business, during the term.
The Contractor bars any suit against the Owner unless filed within 21 days of the cause of action.
The Author assigns the copyright in the manuscript to the Publisher for India for seven years.
The Developer assigns its intellectual property in the source code to the Company; the Company shall own all modifications.
